config_verbatim:
# The PRIME re-baseline on qwen3-embedding-0.6b.
#
# Exists because the embedder changed again. Every PRIME arm in `results/` is
# either Nemotron-3-Embed-1B or nomic-embed-text, and comparing a qwen number
# against either requires that nothing else moved.
#
# ## The chunker is `capped-whole-2400` and that is deliberate
#
# qwen does NOT need the cap. It is served with `n_ctx 32768` and a physical
# batch that took a 40,000-character input in one piece -- probed against the
# live endpoint before this config was written, not inferred from the GGUF.
# The whole corpus would come through whole; PRIME's longest document is
# 52,260 characters and the mean is 870.
#
# The cap is kept anyway, at nomic's value, because `nomic-wholedoc` is the
# arm this is compared against and nomic could not exceed 2400. Lifting it
# here would vary the model AND the granularity at once -- exactly the
# confound `nomic-wholedoc.yaml` documents regretting when it inherited
# Nemotron's 5000-character cap. RESULTS.md finding 4 measures a 25% spread
# in dense mrr across chunkers, so the cap is not a free variable.
#
# `qwen-wholedoc` minus `nomic-wholedoc` is therefore the embedding model and
# nothing else. That is the one clean single-variable model comparison this
# repository has ever had, and it is worth giving up an unconstrained
# whole-document arm to get. Running qwen uncapped is a legitimate follow-up
# cell, not this one -- see B-QWEN-UNCAPPED-1.
name: qwen-wholedoc
dataset: prime
split: test-0.1
chunker: capped-whole-2400
embeddings: qwen3-embedding-0.6b
dimension: 1024
aggregation: max
agent: dense
k: 20

# Qwen3-Embedding is asymmetric in a different shape from every other model
# here. The corpus side takes NO prefix -- the empty string is the correct
# value, not an omission -- and the query side takes a one-line instruction
# followed by `Query: `, which is the format the model was trained with.
# Getting this wrong is silent in the usual way: the vectors stay well-formed
# and score plausibly, just below what the model can do.
document_prefix: ""
query_prefix: "Instruct: Given a query, retrieve relevant documents that answer the query\nQuery: "

cost.ann_index_definition: CREATE INDEX kg_chunks_qwen3_embedding_0_6b_1e22db42_hnsw_qwen_wholedoc ON public.kg_chunks_qwen3_embedding_0_6b_1e22db42 USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m='16', ef_construction='64') WHERE (tenant_id = '394ced66-2821-564e-bdf0-e20e0d0a416d'::uuid)
